4.shakir: And the House (Kaaba) that is visited,
4.mohsin_khan: And by the Bait-ul-Ma'mur (the house over the heavens parable to the Ka'bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels);

5.mohsin_khan: And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven).

6.yusuf_ali: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
6.mohsin_khan: And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection).

7.sahih_international: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
7.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
7.yusuf_ali: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
7.shakir: Most surely the punishment of your Lord will come to pass;
7.muhammad_sarwar: the torment of your Lord will inevitably take place
7.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass,
7.arberry: surely thy Lord's chastisement is about to fall;

8.sahih_international: Of it there is no preventer.
8.pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.
8.yusuf_ali: There is none can avert it;-
8.shakir: There shall be none to avert it;
8.muhammad_sarwar: and no one will be able to prevent it.
8.mohsin_khan: There is none that can avert it;
8.arberry: there is none to avert it.

9.sahih_international: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
9.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
9.yusuf_ali: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
9.shakir: On the day when the heaven shall move from side to side
9.muhammad_sarwar: On the day when the heavens will swiftly fly
9.mohsin_khan: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,
9.arberry: Upon the day when heaven spins dizzily

10.sahih_international: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
10.pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
10.yusuf_ali: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
10.shakir: And the mountains shall pass away passing away (altogether).
10.mohsin_khan: And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement.
10.arberry: and the mountains are in motion,

11.sahih_international: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
11.pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers
11.yusuf_ali: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
11.shakir: So woe on that day to those who reject (the truth),
11.muhammad_sarwar: Woe will be to those who rejected the Truth
11.mohsin_khan: Then woe that Day to the beliers;
11.arberry: woe that day unto those that cry lies,

12.sahih_international: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
12.pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;
12.yusuf_ali: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
12.shakir: Those who sport entering into vain discourses.
12.muhammad_sarwar: and who indulged in false disputes against (God's revelations).

13.sahih_international: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
13.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
13.yusuf_ali: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
13.shakir: The day on which they shall be driven away to the fire of hell with violence.
13.muhammad_sarwar: On that day they will be violently pushed into the fire
13.mohsin_khan: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.
13.arberry: the day when they shall be pitched into the fire of Gehenna:

14.sahih_international: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
14.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
14.yusuf_ali: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
14.shakir: This is the fire which you used to give the lie to.
14.muhammad_sarwar: and they will be told, "This is the fire which you called a lie.
14.mohsin_khan: This is the Fire which you used to belie.
14.arberry: 'This is the fire that you cried lies to!

15.sahih_international: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
15.pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
15.yusuf_ali: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
15.shakir: Is it magic then or do you not see?
15.muhammad_sarwar: Is it magic or do you not still see?
15.mohsin_khan: Is this magic, or do you not see?
15.arberry: What, is this magic, or is it you that do not see?

16.sahih_international: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
16.pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
16.yusuf_ali: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
16.shakir: Enter into it, then bear (it) patiently, or do not bear (it) patiently, it is the same to you; you shall be requited only (for) what you did.
16.muhammad_sarwar: Burn in its heat. It is all the same for you whether you exercise patience or not; This is the recompense for your deeds".
16.mohsin_khan: Taste you therein its heat, and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.
16.arberry: Roast in it! And bear you patiently, or bear not patiently, equal it is to you; you are only being recompensed for that you were working.'

17.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
17.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
17.yusuf_ali: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
17.shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be in gardens and bliss
17.muhammad_sarwar: The pious will live in bountiful Paradise,
17.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) will be in Gardens (Paradise), and Delight.
17.arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be in gardens and bliss,

18.sahih_international: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
18.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
18.yusuf_ali: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
18.shakir: Rejoicing because of what their Lord gave them, and their Lord saved them from the punishment of the burning fire.
18.muhammad_sarwar: talking of what they have received from their Lord and of how their Lord has saved them from the torment of hell.
18.mohsin_khan: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.
18.arberry: rejoicing in that their Lord has given them; and their Lord shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell.

19.sahih_international: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
19.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
19.yusuf_ali: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
19.shakir: Eat and drink pleasantly for what you did,
19.muhammad_sarwar: They will be told, "Eat and drink to your heart's delight for what you have done".
19.mohsin_khan: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."
19.arberry: 'Eat and drink, with wholesome appetite, for that you were working.

20.sahih_international: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
20.pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
20.yusuf_ali: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
20.shakir: Reclining on thrones set in lines, and We will unite them to large-eyed beautiful ones.
20.muhammad_sarwar: They will recline on couches arranged in rows and We shall couple them with maidens with large, lovely eyes.
20.mohsin_khan: They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Houris (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes.
20.arberry: Reclining upon couches ranged in rows; and We shall espouse them to wide-eyed houris.

21.sahih_international: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
21.pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
21.yusuf_ali: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
21.shakir: And (as for) those who believe and their offspring follow them in faith, We will unite with them their offspring and We will not diminish to them aught of their work; every man is responsible for what he shall have wrought.
21.muhammad_sarwar: The offspring of the believers will also follow them to Paradise. So shall We join their offspring to them because of their faith. We shall reduce nothing from their deeds. Everyone will be responsible for his own actions.
21.mohsin_khan: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith, to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.
21.arberry: And those who believed, and their seed followed them in belief, We shall join their seed with them, and We shall not defraud them of aught of their work; every man shall be pledged for what he earned.

22.sahih_international: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
22.pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
22.yusuf_ali: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
22.shakir: And We will aid them with fruit and flesh such as they desire.
22.muhammad_sarwar: We shall provide them with fruits and the meat of the kind which they desire.
22.mohsin_khan: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat, such as they desire.
22.arberry: And We shall succour them with fruits and flesh such as they desire

23.sahih_international: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
23.pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
23.yusuf_ali: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
23.shakir: They shall pass therein from one to another a cup wherein there shall be nothing vain nor any sin.
23.muhammad_sarwar: They will pass cups of un-intoxicating and unsinful wine to one another.
23.mohsin_khan: There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vague talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be legal for them to drink).
23.arberry: while they pass therein a cup one to another wherein is no idle talk, no cause of sin,

24.sahih_international: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
24.pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
24.yusuf_ali: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
24.shakir: And round them shall go boys of theirs as if they were hidden pearls.
24.muhammad_sarwar: They will be served by youths who will be as beautiful as pearls.
24.mohsin_khan: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.
24.arberry: and there go round them youths, their own, as if they were hidden pearls.

25.sahih_international: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
25.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
25.yusuf_ali: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
25.shakir: And some of them shall advance towards others questioning each other.
25.muhammad_sarwar: They will turn to one another ask questions,
25.mohsin_khan: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.
25.arberry: They advance one upon another, asking each other questions.

26.sahih_international: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
26.pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
26.yusuf_ali: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
26.shakir: Saying: Surely we feared before on account of our families:
26.muhammad_sarwar: saying, "We were afraid while in the world.
26.mohsin_khan: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid with our families (from the punishment of Allah).
26.arberry: They say, 'We were before among our people, ever going in fear,

27.sahih_international: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
27.pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
27.yusuf_ali: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
27.shakir: But Allah has been gracious to us and He has saved us from the punishment of the hot wind:
27.muhammad_sarwar: But God has granted us favors and saved us from the scorching heat of the torment.
27.mohsin_khan: "But Allah has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.
27.arberry: and God was gracious to us, and guarded us against the chastisement of the burning wind;

28.sahih_international: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
28.pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
28.yusuf_ali: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
28.shakir: Surely we called upon Him before: Surely He is the Benign, the Merciful.
28.muhammad_sarwar: We had prayed to Him; He is Kind and All-merciful".
28.mohsin_khan: "Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful."
28.arberry: we were before ever calling upon Him; surely He is the All-benign, the All-compassionate.'

29.sahih_international: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
29.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
29.yusuf_ali: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
29.shakir: Therefore continue to remind, for by the grace of your Lord, you are not a soothsayer, or a madman.
29.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), remind them, by the Grace of your Lord, that you are neither a soothsayer or an insane person.
29.mohsin_khan: Therefore, remind and preach (mankind, O Muhammad SAW of Islamic Monotheism). By the Grace of Allah, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.
29.arberry: Therefore remind! by thy Lord's blessing thou art not a soothsayer neither possessed.

30.sahih_international: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
30.pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
30.yusuf_ali: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
30.shakir: Or do they say: A poet, we wait for him the evil accidents of time.
30.muhammad_sarwar: Do they say, "He is only a poet and we are waiting to see him die!?"
30.mohsin_khan: Or do they say: "(Muhammad SAW is) a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!
30.arberry: Or do they say, 'He is a poet for whom we await Fate's uncertainty'?

31.sahih_international: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
31.pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
31.yusuf_ali: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
31.shakir: Say: Wait, for surely I too with you am of those who wait.
31.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Wait, I too am waiting with you".
31.mohsin_khan: Say (O Muhammad SAW to them): "Wait! I am with you, among the waiters!"
31.arberry: Say: 'Await! I shall be awaiting with you.'

32.sahih_international: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
32.pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
32.yusuf_ali: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
32.shakir: Nay! do their understandings bid them this? Or are they an inordinate people?
32.muhammad_sarwar: Does their reason tell them to say this or is it because they are a rebellious people?
32.mohsin_khan: Do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad SAW)] or are they people exceeding the bounds (i.e. from Belief in Allah to disbelief).
32.arberry: Or do their intellects bid them do this? Or are they an insolent people?

33.sahih_international: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
33.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
33.yusuf_ali: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
33.shakir: Or do they say: He has forged it. Nay! they do not believe.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Do they say, "He has falsely invented it (the Quran)?" In fact, they themselves have no faith.
33.mohsin_khan: Or do they say: "He (Muhammad SAW) has forged it (this Quran)?" Nay! They believe not!
33.arberry: Or do they say, 'He has invented it?' Nay, but they do not believe.

34.sahih_international: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
34.pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
34.yusuf_ali: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
34.shakir: Then let them bring an announcement like it if they are truthful.
34.muhammad_sarwar: Let them produce a discourse like it if they are true in their claim.
34.mohsin_khan: Let them then produce a recital like unto it (the Quran) if they are truthful.
34.arberry: Then let them bring a discourse like it, if they speak truly.

35.sahih_international: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
35.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
35.yusuf_ali: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
35.shakir: Or were they created without there being anything, or are they the creators?
35.muhammad_sarwar: Have they been created from nothing or are they themselves their own creators?
35.mohsin_khan: Were they created by nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
35.arberry: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?

36.sahih_international: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
36.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
36.yusuf_ali: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
36.shakir: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay! they have no certainty.
36.muhammad_sarwar: Have they created the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no strong faith.
36.mohsin_khan: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.
36.arberry: Or did they create the heavens and earth? Nay, but they have not sure faith.

37.sahih_international: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
37.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
37.yusuf_ali: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
37.shakir: Or have they the treasures of your Lord with them? Or have they been set in absolute authority?
37.muhammad_sarwar: Do they own the treasures of your Lord? Have they any authority over God?
37.mohsin_khan: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?
37.arberry: Or are thy Lord's treasuries in their keeping? Or are they the registrars?

38.sahih_international: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
38.pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
38.yusuf_ali: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
38.shakir: Or have they the means by which they listen? Then let their listener bring a clear authority.
38.muhammad_sarwar: Do they have a ladder (by which they can climb up to the heavens) and listen (to the angels) and come back to the rest of the people with clear authority?
38.mohsin_khan: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.
38.arberry: Or have they a ladder whereon they listen? Then let any of them that has listened bring a clear authority.

39.sahih_international: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
39.pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
39.yusuf_ali: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
39.shakir: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
39.muhammad_sarwar: Do the daughters belong to Him and the sons to you?
39.mohsin_khan: Or has He (Allah) only daughters and you have sons?
39.arberry: Or has He daughters, and they sons?

40.sahih_international: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
40.pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
40.yusuf_ali: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
40.shakir: Or do you ask them for a reward, so that they are overburdened by a debt?
40.muhammad_sarwar: Do you (Muhammad) ask them for any payment (for your preaching) which they cannot afford?
40.mohsin_khan: Or is it that you (O Muhammad SAW) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islamic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?
40.arberry: Or askest thou them for a wage, and so they are weighed down with debt?

41.sahih_international: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
41.pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
41.yusuf_ali: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
41.shakir: Or have they the unseen so that they write (it) down?
41.muhammad_sarwar: Do they have knowledge of the unseen, thus, are able to predict (the future)?
41.mohsin_khan: Or that the Ghaib (unseen) is with them, and they write it down?
41.arberry: Or is the Unseen in their keeping, and so they are writing it down?

42.sahih_international: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
42.pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
42.yusuf_ali: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
42.shakir: Or do they desire a war? But those who disbelieve shall be the vanquished ones in war.
42.muhammad_sarwar: Do they design evil plans? The disbelievers themselves will be snared by their evil plots.
42.mohsin_khan: Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad SAW)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) are themselves in a plot!
42.arberry: Or desire they to outwit? The unbelievers, they are the outwitted.

43.sahih_international: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
43.pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
43.yusuf_ali: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
43.shakir: Or have they a god other than Allah? Glory be to Allah from what they set up (with Him).
43.muhammad_sarwar: Do they have another god besides God? God is too exalted to be considered equal to the idols.
43.mohsin_khan: Or have they an ilah (a god) other than Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)
43.arberry: Or have they a god, other than God? Glory be to God, above that which they associate!

44.sahih_international: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
44.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
44.yusuf_ali: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
44.shakir: And if they should see a portion of the heaven coming down, they would say: Piled up clouds.
44.muhammad_sarwar: Even if they were to see a part of the heavens falling down upon them, they would say, "It is only dense cloud".
44.mohsin_khan: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
44.arberry: Even if they saw lumps falling from heaven, they would say, 'A massed cloud!'

45.sahih_international: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
45.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
45.yusuf_ali: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
45.shakir: Leave them then till they meet that day of theirs wherein they shall be made to swoon (with terror):
45.muhammad_sarwar: So leave them alone until they face the day when they will be struck dead from terror
45.mohsin_khan: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).
45.arberry: Then leave them, till they encounter their day wherein they shall be thunderstruck,

46.sahih_international: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
46.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
46.yusuf_ali: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
46.shakir: The day on which their struggle shall not avail them aught, nor shall they be helped.
46.muhammad_sarwar: and when their evil plans will be of no benefit to them nor will they be helped.
46.mohsin_khan: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).
46.arberry: the day when their guile shall avail them naught, and they shall not be helped.

47.sahih_international: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
47.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
47.yusuf_ali: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
47.shakir: And surely those who are unjust shall have a punishment besides that (in the world), but most of them do not know.
47.muhammad_sarwar: The unjust will suffer other torments besides this but most of them do not know.
47.mohsin_khan: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) before this, but most of them know not. [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 27, Page 36].
47.arberry: And there surely awaits the evildoers a chastisement beyond even that, but most of them know it not.

48.sahih_international: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
48.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
48.yusuf_ali: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
48.shakir: And wait patiently for the judgment of your Lord, for surely you are before Our eyes, and sing the praise of your Lord when you rise;
48.muhammad_sarwar: Wait patiently for the command of your Lord. We are watching over you. Glorify your Lord when you rise during the night
48.mohsin_khan: So wait patiently (O Muhammad SAW) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes, and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.
48.arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,

49.sahih_international: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
49.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
49.yusuf_ali: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
49.shakir: And in the night, give Him glory too, and at the setting of the stars.
49.muhammad_sarwar: and glorify Him after the setting of the stars.
49.mohsin_khan: And in the night time, also glorify His Praises, and at the setting of the stars.
49.arberry: and proclaim the praise of thy Lord in the night, and at the declining of the stars.
